fields.aka: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, Vṛndāvana dāsa, the Vyāsa of Caitanya-līlā
fields.place: Born at Māmagāchi (Modadrumadvīpa, Navadvīpa), in the house of Vāsudeva Datta (Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa: at Kumārahaṭṭa); Śrīpāṭa at Denuḍa (his Gaura-Nitāi). The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna (Tīrthas, «Hālisahara»): born at Nati, south of Hālisahara
fields.works: Śrī Caitanya-bhāgavata (first called Caitanya-maṅgala; about 1548); padas in the Padakalpataru

fields.name: Locana dāsa Ṭhākura
fields.place: Born at Kogrāma (Kāṭoyā subdivision, Burdwan); lived at his guru's Śrīpāṭa, Śrīkhaṇḍa
fields.works: Śrī Caitanya-maṅgala (between 1482 and 1488 Śaka); Durlabha-sāra; Bengali verse of the Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka and of the Rāsa-pañcādhyāyī; songs (dhāmālī) on Gaura and Nityānanda

fields.disappearance: 1424 Śaka (1502 AD), while the Lord was in East Bengal (Digdarśanī)
